page: Amazon Web Services c8id.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores running at 3.9 GHz. The processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations. It is equipped with 128 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.

For local storage, the instance includes 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, offering high-speed local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps. Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in multi-core operations, software compilation, and image processing, alongside strong memory bandwidth and cryptographic execution. The hardware profile delivers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring dense compute resources paired with fast local storage, avoiding the overhead of external network-attached storage.

This instance is highly suited for compute-intensive and storage-dependent workloads. Recommended applications include high-performance web serving, database operations, software compilation pipelines, and CPU-based machine learning inference, particularly prompt processing for large language models.
